| Technology | Reason | Approved Alternative |

| <!-- e.g. Java 8 --> | <!-- e.g. End of public updates --> | <!-- e.g. Java 21 LTS --> |

|---------|--------|---------------------|

## Required Elements

Every modernized application must include:

### Cloud Resources
<!-- e.g. Health check endpoints, auto-scaling configuration -->

### Monitoring
<!-- e.g. Structured logging (JSON), distributed tracing, alerting -->

### CI/CD
<!-- e.g. Automated pipeline, security scanning gate, staged rollout -->

### Testing
<!-- e.g. Unit test coverage >= 80%, integration tests, container image scanning -->
